name: Giza
notes: This export arrived as a bare splat_full.ply with no semantics_metadata, so scaleFactor is identity and groundPlaneOffset (1.17) was measured from the raw PLY: the lowest surface sits at raw y=+1.17 in OpenCV coordinates. That puts the ground at y=0 and the camera 1.17 units above it, which is walkable but NOT metric - moveSpeed and bounds.radiusM are in raw units, not metres. Replace both values from the Marble export's semantics_metadata when it is available. source.image and fovY are inherited from the earlier Giza world and are unconfirmed for this export; provenance output is meaningless until they are verified and the photographer pose is aligned.
